notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 Notes
notes.content: [p]It's been just over a month since Draggin' released, time flies![/p][p]And just in time to celebrate, we set a new patch for Draggin' live. Our lead programmer (me) has been juggling some other important work recently (playing Hollow Knight: Silksong), but we've put together some new additions and fixes we think will make the game a lot more user-friendly.[/p][p]Here's our list of changes for the new 1.0.2 update:[/p][p][/p][h3][u]Additions:[/u][/h3][p]- Clicking is now rebindable from the settings menu![/p][p]- The life bar now has some new sprites that appear when you heal to show you how close you are to max health.[/p][p]- The Combo Meter has some new little icons to make it clearer what the numbers on it actually mean.[/p][p]- Added a few new supported resolutions (QHD and 4K UHD, specifically). That should make the game look nicer on 4k monitors![/p][p][/p][h3][u]Balance Changes:[/u][/h3][p]- Heart drop rate is now tied to how much health you have (more hearts show up when you're low, fewer when you have a lot already).[/p][p]- Health Potions heal 2 hearts instead of 3.[/p][p]- College Fund goal has been raised from 150k to 500k. We've been super impressed with how fast some of y'all are getting Margot to college, so we gotta make it a little tougher.[/p][p][/p][h3][u]Fixes:[/u][/h3][p]- The "Potions" header on the Spellbook screen shows up in the right place now.[/p][p]- Fixed the issue where the combo meter would disappear if you started another combo during its fade out animation.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all for playing! As always, if you run into any issues in the new build, or have any feedback for us, the Discord is a great place to make sure we hear about it! We've got some big announcements coming up on the horizon, so stay tuned![/p][p][/p][p]Enjoy the new patch, everyone! Now if you'll excuse me, I have to go play Silksong for the next 8 hours.[/p][p]- Alex from Dragon Fractal[/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 Notes
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539499/b64ae7e5a1ec312ea19555b241e6e592286ffbc3.png"][/img][/p][p]It's time for Draggin's first patch! Welcome to 1.0.1.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much to everyone who has been giving their feedback or bug reports in our Discord. We've been getting a ton of great info from you on how we can make Draggin a bigger and better game.[/p][p][/p][p]Speaking of making Draggin a better game, here's a list of what we've fixed up with this update![/p][list][*][p]The Lace spell box effect scales properly now.[/p][/*][*][p]Combo meter description should no longer permanently rotate when you take damage.[/p][/*][*][p]The background of the graduation screen now actually covers the whole screen.[/p][/*][*][p]The damage vignette effect no longer flashes on screen when toggling it in the settings menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some visual bugs with the blue and purple square spark effects.[/p][/*][*][p]The Winter, Graduate, and Regal costumes now display correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Made some adjustments to the College Fund Meter in the main menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the wording of the Prism spell to match what it actually does. (oops)[/p][/*][*][p]Hoppin draggins should no longer jitter violently when too close to the Fruit spell's sprout.[/p][/*][*][p]Drag Racing challenge now works as intended.[/p][/*][*][p]Hitless challenges should now unlock consistently when earned.[/p][/*][*][p]Gold pickups no longer add a message to the combo meter, making it easier to see the names of captured draggins.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]If YOU run into any bugs or have ideas you'd like to see in a future update, hop into our Discord and let us know! We'd be thrilled to see you![/p][p][/p][p]Keep your eyes peeled for more updates and maybe even some sneak peeks at what we're going to be cooking up next.[/p][p][/p][p]- The Dragon Fractal team[/p]

notes.title: Demo 0.2.1 - Localization and More Music!
notes.content: [h3]New Stuff! [/h3][list][*][p]Localization! Draggin now supports Japanese, Korean, and Russian languages in addition to English. Traditional Chinese is also on the way![/p][/*][*][p]Added a brand-new music track for the Castle environment featured in the demo's Endless Mode[/p][/*][/list][h3] Fixes and Tweaks! [/h3][list][*][p]Updated tutorial section for smoothness and readability[/p][/*][*][p]Increased opacity of combo meter when overlapped by a Draggin or the player[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted positioning of some UI elements for better visual clarity[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539499/f7fffc34822439bd6b1e953ac25cab0b41ea61da.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539499/32c3ccb667e189a0309446c8126213c830389686.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: New Demo for Steam Next Fest 🐲✨
notes.content:
Hello all Draggin' catchers,

We're excited to share with y'all that we will be showcasing a brand new demo during Steam Next Fest - and it releases right now!

[h1]What's new:[/h1]
[list]
[*] 12 hand-picked challenges have been added to the demo! Check out the Challenges Menu to learn about them and the new goodies they unlock!
[*] 4 new Spells from the full game
[*] 4 new Costumes, alongside new Sparks and Patterns for your Spellbox
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539499/ddba141926146c8e07f35dfff19390d6d69045b2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539499/86bb1ea2e43a4b095946dca302eadba6feaa4f11.png[/img]

There's still plenty more for us to work on. If you have any feedback you'd like to give us leave a review over on our demo page! It helps us out a lot.

Have fun catchin' those Draggins!
